description.value:
This detailed die-cast metal truck fits in the palm of the hand, appearing to be nothing more than a high-end toy or collectible model. With a single command word, however, it can instantly expand into a full-sized, fully functional vehicle. Torchbox trucks are available in a wide variety of designs, though they all have the same statistics.

Activate—Expand 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Requirements The truck is in its miniature form, and there's enough space to fit its vehicle form

Effect The torchbox truck instantly expands to full size next to you. In its vehicle form, the torchbox truck has the statistics of an all-terrain dune buggy.

Activate—Contract 1 (concentrate, manipulate)

Requirements The truck is in its vehicle form

Effect The torchbox truck instantly contracts into its miniature form, appearing in your hand. Any passengers appear in spaces adjacent to you.
